Maintenance Procedures Information System

sections_en.text: This document sets out the calibration steps

The first draft of this document was prepared by Eng. Marwa El-Sayed El-Hadidy and Eng. Amal Hamed El-Maken, reviewed by Eng. Magdy Saad El-Khamis Gad El-Haq, tested by Eng. Wagdy Eid Mansour on 14 July 2005, approved by the General Manager Eng. Yousry Ahmed Abdel Maksoud, reviewed by Eng. Abdel Monem El-Emam, Manager of the Instrumentation and Electricity Department in the Inspection Sector of the East Delta Electricity Production Company, and approved by Eng. Fathy Mahmoud Ragab, Head of the Talkha Power Station Sector.

It was approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Galil, General Manager of Inspection and Quality of the East Delta Electricity Production Company and MPIS Coordinator, and approved by Mr. Accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman, General Manager of Financial and Administrative Control and Supervisor of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector.
Safety Precautions
Issue a work permit, with an industrial safety category card available for the personnel on site
Fence off the area, using the appropriate warning signs
Use personal protective equipment (PPE) such as a safety helmet and safety shoes, etc.
The unit must be isolated and shut down and be in a cooled-down state before starting the test

sections_en.text: Mercury thermometer (0–212 °F)
Procedures to be Carried Out
Calibration of STKJ for the TX signal

rows: Insert the thermometer in the back of the STKJ card for 15 minutes, then remove the front of the Thermocouple module switches, and switch OFF all the switches

Connect an mV source from C4,5 on the calibrator to in, +in on the TX-A channel, then connect a digital voltmeter (DVM) to measure this mV, and connect another DVM at Acom & Out for the TX-A channel to measure the output of the STKJ card
Calculate the true mV value from the following relation: mV = 0.02248 (TAF - 32) - (recorded) mV, correction factor @ 1.02. Actual mV = TX - Correction Factor
Repeat steps (2–3) to calibrate the Temp. Meter
Repeat steps (2–3) to calibrate the STKJ cards for the (OTA & OTB) signals

sections_en.text: Calibration of Pressure Compressor Discharge (PCD)

rows: Disconnect the air signal line and connect it to an external air line (0–150 PSI)
Measure the output of 96CD according to the following table:

sections_en.text: Calibration of the PCDN signal on the IC3600 STKK card

rows: Inject volts at D3 from D2 at the values in the table; also inject mV until the Temp control lamp lights, noting the output at D4 & Acom, and achieve the following table

sections_en.text: Calibration of the base load signal

rows: Connect a digital voltmeter to Pin 9 of the STKK card at (G01R02) Acom, (D03R04), then connect D2 to D3 to inject and measure the voltage representing the compressor pressure

Connect an mV source from C4,5 to +1N, -1N; also measure the output of this mV with another digital voltmeter from out & A com on the front of the switches, and this voltage can be measured from D4 & Acom; this reading is the voltage representing the temperature, and the temperature can be obtained as follows:
Temperature in Fahrenheit = (200) × voltage reading from (D4, Acom)
Make Max. VCE by connecting (D10Y & A com).
Inject volts at D3 from D2 at the values in the table; also inject mV until the Temp control lamp lights, noting the output at D4 & Acom, and achieve the following table:

sections_en.text: Note: Inject the volts representing the compressor pressure as in each step, then inject mV until the Temp. control lamp lights

rows: Leave the connections as they are

sections_en.text: Calibration of the peak load signal

rows: Use the same previous connections as in the Base signal
Raise the Temp. Control limit by placing Logic (0) on Pin (3) in the SPOA card.

Inject volts at D3 from D2 (PCD Pressure) at the values in the table; also inject mV until the Temp control lamp lights, noting the drop in the VCE value and noting the output at D4 & Acom, and achieve the following table:
